pro_course_detail.description:
I offer four full comprehensive courses in preparation for the IELTS Test-speaking, writing, reading and listening. The courses will teach you exactly what you need to know. I use only the most recent questions actually used in IELTS tests around the world for the most accurate and current test experience. Grammar, vocabulary, intonation and inflection correction and advise are offered so you are well-prepared and confident to take the test.

We repeatedly practice all sections of the test with a new set of questions each time: Speaking Eg.

Part 1 - Interview Questions:
This section is usually simple "interview style" questions about you but the questions here can abruptly change to completely unrelated topics to test your comprehension and composure. This is where the interviewer gets an idea of your level of English.

Part 2 - Topic Question:
This is the timed "long turn" section. You are given a cue card with the topic printed on it. The card usually has 2-4 questions about the topic. You have one minute to prepare and up to three minutes to present your answer. If you take too longer to answer all the questions, I teach you simple but effective strategies to ensure you answer all the questions first before your time runs out.

Part 3 - General Discussion Questions.
This section is usually follow up questions related to the topic on the cue card. This is where you can best demonstrate your ability to use complex language. 

I understand how important this test is for most people who take it. It often means being able to start a new life in a new country or attend the university of your dreams. Because I know how much depends on the outcome of this test, I take very seriously the responsibility to help you reach the band score you need. I have successfully guided many students to achieve the band score they need and you can feel confident that you will be prepared going into the IELTS Test with the support and guidance of a qualified, professional ESL teacher.

Whatever your reason(s) for learning English, my goal is to provide you with the ideal environment for improving your skills. Also, to make you feel more comfortable, I will do my best to adjust my teaching style and the focus of our lessons to your needs.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

As for my teaching style, I'll ensure that you feel relaxed by being encouraging. I'll also focus on helping you to correct your mistakes and speak English in a way that's similar to a native speaker, which will improve the quality of your English communication! pro_course_detail.title: General Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: In these sessions, we'll focus on the skill of having natural conversations in English. Whatever your current level, we'll improve your speaking and listening skills together in a relaxed environment. Feel free to choose the topic and we'll go from there. If you would prefer for me to choose the topic, that's fine too. See you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Fluency Upgrade
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to speak English more confidently and fluently? Do you find it difficult to express exactly what you would like to say sometimes? If so, then these classes will be suitable for you. 

We'll work on using new words and expressions, which will help you to feel more comfortable when speaking English. Also, we will spend some time on perfecting your pronunciation and I'll give you tips on how you can improve all aspects of your spoken English. See you in the classroom soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Active Correction
pro_course_detail.description:
In these active correction classes, our focus will be on perfecting your spoken English. You may already have a good level of speaking and understanding but we'll endeavour to improve your skills further. 

When you make mistakes, I'll make notes in the chat so that you can see how to make your English more coherent and natural. In these classes, we'll learn how to use idioms and we'll concentrate on some of the finer details of the English language as well. 

By doing this, you'll become a more confident speaker and be able to take your English to the next level. If you think that you'd be interested in these classes, please get in touch and we'll get started. See you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Reading
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to get more out of reading in English? Would you like to read aloud more fluently? In these lessons, we'll focus on helping you to become a more proficient reader. To achieve this, we can use texts that you've chosen yourself or I can source materials for us to discuss. 

Reading is a two-fold skill, which involves being able to correctly interpret the intent of the writer and, when reading aloud, convey the meaning of the text accurately through good pronunciation and intonation. As we work on this important skill together, I'll endeavour to provide you with feedback that will help you to enhance both your ability to understand what you're reading and read aloud. 

I look forward to working with you in these lessons!

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Writing (Creativity & Proofreading)
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to be able to write more confidently and eloquently? In these lessons, we'll focus on helping you to become a better writer. 

We can work on improving texts that you've already written or we can focus on how to use more complex expressions and language to enhance the quality of your writing. Emphasis will be placed on accuracy and appropriate use of grammar, depending on the type of text and desired style.

I look forward to working with you in these lessons!

pro_course_detail.title: A Guide To British English (Commonly Used Expressions, Culture & Idioms)
pro_course_detail.description:
Get to know British English and the British culture! 

An effective way to do this is to discuss similarities and differences between your own culture and the British culture. By doing this, your understanding of the language will also improve and you'll be able to fully enjoy your stay in the UK and/or time spent with British people.

I'm sure you'll find it interesting to learn about idioms and other common expressions, as this will give you an insight into the mentality of the people who live in the UK. We can also talk about the origins of these expressions, if you like. 

I look forward to speaking to you in these lessons!

Do you want your English to sound lovely to your listener? 

I have a system that works! Improve the sound of your English with a native Brit! No more trying to fake a British accent. In these classes you will learn the British accent intuitively. I will teach you, using simple methods, how to pronounce words and syllables so that your delivery of English sounds natural and convincing.

This course teaches all of the important and intricate aspects of modern Received Pronunciation and places particular focus on vowel & consonant pronunciation, word & sentence stress, connected speech and intonation; with taught practical methods for training your mouth to make those British sounds!

Students receive an initial assessment followed by training personalised to their accent and have access to hundreds of downloadable audio and visual files to assist learning. Through drilling, repetition, reading and conversation we will work together to help you achieve the accent you want.
